newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Jean-Christophe Filori said the Commission had decided to grant 280 Mecus for trans-European transport networks within the 1996 budget. He said 75 percent of this sum would be dedicated to the 14 projects confirmed by the Essen European Council, among which a majority were rail projects. Filori said 352 Mecus were foreseen in this sector for 1997 as well as an additional 100 Mecus for the central and eastern European countries in the framework of the PHARE programme.

In answer to a question, spokesman Peter Jorgensen said the Commission had proposed that the Council accept the negotiations on leg-hold traps which have taken place with Canada and Russia and to continue to negotiate with the U.S.
Spokesman Vale de Almeida said there would be no midday briefing between Tuesday 24 December and Thursday 2 January. He said several spokesmen would, however, be available during that period.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1211: Commission clears Spanish environmental programme.
- IP/96/1212: Commission grants ECU 170 million for the Italian "Energia" programme.
- IP/96/1213: MEDA: ECU 55 million financing in favour of Morocco and Lebanon.
- IP/96/1214: Commission clears a notified agreement concerning Britannia gas field.
- IP/96/1215: Commission clears the creation of Iridium, a future provider of worldwide satellite personal communications services (S-PCS).
- IP/96/1216: Commission acts on major accident hazards and takes legal action against Germany and Spain.
- IP/96/1218: Commission acts to protect wild birds in France and to ensure habitat protection in Ireland.
- IP/96/1220: Commission takes legal action against Belgium and Ireland for not implementing rules concerning water pollution.
- IP/96/1223: Policy advice to the governments of the New Independent States and Mongolia: TACIS signs a contract for ECU 12 million.
- IP/96/1224: Commission grants substantial financial support for the trans-European transport networks.
- IP/96/1225: Safe transport of radioactive materials: the European Commission finances 18 studies.
- IP/96/1226: PHARE funds help to smooth ethnic differences in Estonia.
- IP/96/1227: Commissioner Hans van den Broek visits Hungary, 19-20 December 1996.
